messages.subject: Feature request: Percent identity cutoff
parts:
Hi - Thanks for developing featureCounts, it's really a great straightforward piece of software. 

I'd love to be able to filter mappings based on a minimum percent identity match to the reference. Similar to how "-Q" works. 

Thanks so much!

messages.subject: Re: Feature request: Percent identity cutoff
parts:

messages.author: 409724ca41bbb55c
messages.subject: Re: Feature request: Percent identity cutoff
parts:
Hi -  '--fracOverlap'  sounds like the fraction of the read that aligns. I am thinking of something like the percent of bases that exactly match the reference for the part that does align. So for example - a read with "ATCG" and a reference with "ATGGCC" the percent identity would be 75%.

Best
Rohan
